case_number: WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) NO.740 OF 1986; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 39 OF 1991

parties.petitioner: Central Board of Dawoodi Bohra Community & Anr.

summary: Ex-communication practice within Dawoodi Bohra community and its constitutional validity under Article 26; repeal of Ex-communication Act by Social Boycott Act 2016 examined; survival of writ petition questioned; reconsideration of Sardar Syedna Taher Saifuddin Saheb 1962 ruling disputed; conflict between religious rights under Article 26 and fundamental rights such as Articles 14, 19, 21, 17; constitutional morality as integral to interpret 'morality' under Article 26; whether ex-communication violates liberty & equality; tagging with Sabrimala 9-Judge referral considered; unregistered petitioners' standing challenged; impugned law already repealed, petition possibly infructuous.
legal_provisions_cited: Maharashtra Protection of People from Social Boycott Act 2016 Section 20
